prompt_sentence: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

logit_row.bytes: one verify row, raw fp16, same payload as the round0 bin

export.rows: prefill chunk length, or verify q_len
export.bytes: params['export_states'][-1] after the target forward; the list has length 1

block_in.bytes: input x of TransformerBlock.forward, layers 0..63 in order

cq3_page.bytes: one physical page, all 256 rows, C order. qk/qv are the packed int32 words (token_dim/32*bits per row). sk/sv are the fp16 scales (token_dim/32 per row). Four separate digests, not concatenated.

cq3_rows.bytes: draft only. concatenation of the written rows in position order. position p is page phys_of[p//256], row p%256. other rows on the page are not included. speculative draft_model.forward rows are not included.

conv.bytes: slot 0, the whole tensor, including the history tail past conv_k

logit_bins.bytes: raw little-endian fp16, no header. verify index 0, row 0 only

omissions: speculative draft_model.forward rows (the anchor at position P and the draft tail refresh does not overwrite) are not hashed
8190 block_in is not comparable to testdata/prefill_ref (33 pages, class other, versus the old 32-page div16 dump)
100 and 1500 block_in[k+1] corresponds to prefill_ref's block-output digest of layer k; this script does not compare them
